title: Maintain fingerprint qualification, drift and reference revocation
summary: Maintain only applicable, source-linked experimental fingerprints and assessments as rosters, rooms, microphones, questions, models and reference permissions change. Revocation invalidates affected future hints while historical receipts remain reproducible; no automatic enrollment or threshold relaxation follows.
out_of_scope: Automatic production retraining, deployment or identity policy changes
Deleting original evidence because an experimental matter resolved
Treating expired qualification as valid through cache reuse
implementation: Define profile compatibility keys covering corpus/provenance map, source references, roster/role regime, extractor/model/question/threshold versions and supported population/time scope.

Detect bounded changes in feature availability and distributions by meeting/role/channel; record drift and propose requalification instead of silently widening applicability or relaxing confidence thresholds.
Apply source corrections and revoked reference samples through dependency invalidation; prevent them entering future profiles/packets and withdraw or regenerate pending private attention.

Preserve old assessment/package/configuration receipts and reference dispositions so historical results remain inspectable; separately record privacy/retention actions under the domain's approved policy.

Create a staged pilot qualification and rollback receipt with executed/unrun checks, quality/cost/coverage deltas and explicit operator scope for any future real inference; production remains untouched.

acceptance.criterion: A revoked sample cannot support new or queued assessments while historical receipts retain the original evidence basis.
acceptance.verification: Revoke a shared reference after assessment selection and verify dependency invalidation, no fresh use and preserved historical manifests.

acceptance.criterion: Expired, mismatched or failed qualification cannot be bypassed by a cached model result.
acceptance.verification: Replay cached answers across question/model/profile changes and inspect named unqualified outcomes.

acceptance.criterion: Chair/channel/roster drift creates explicit regime/requalification state rather than automatic identity changes.
acceptance.verification: Run controlled profile shifts and compare production state digests and experimental eligibility.

acceptance.criterion: The maintenance report separates readiness, inference execution and actual production scope.
acceptance.verification: Inspect a pilot receipt with no deployment and verify every future integration gate remains explicitly pending.

tests: Reference revoked through a transitive provenance group
Model alias resolves to a changed version
Chair or roster turnover with the same committee name
Changed question keeps output type but changes semantics
Private retention action preserves required audit disposition
risks: Long-lived profiles may outlast their corpus or authority assumptions.
Drift detection can over-trigger on small samples or miss channel-specific failures.

reuse.application: Reuse immutable decisions/profile version and revocation provenance concepts without modifying enrollment.
Retain frozen run/configuration hashes and execution-mode distinctions.
Use shared dependency invalidation and qualification applicability rather than a second lifecycle authority.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
